pages.text: A station is two blocks tall and hollow: the doorway you step into, and where you step out again. It sits flush against the tube above or below it.$(br2)Stand on a station with a tube going $(o)up$() over it and it lifts you into the network. Put one at the far end of the run and you land in it instead of being thrown out.

pages.title: Getting off early
pages.text: Put stations in series along a run and you can choose where to stop.$(br2)$(o)Sneak$() as you reach one and the floor comes back under you, so you get off there instead of riding to the end. Let go and you carry on.$(br2)Breaking either half of a station takes the other with it.

pages.title: The horizontal station
pages.text: The sideways variant is two blocks long instead of two tall, for getting in and out of a level run.$(br2)It has no item of its own: it is what a station becomes when you build it that way.
